summary: Serve your artifact as a session API: create_session, query_session, delete_session.

create_session.input: {context?: object}  // reserved, currently always absent/empty; artifacts MUST accept it and MAY ignore it, so per-case starting state can be added additively later

framing: application/json (a non-null json field must be valid JSON); large files deferred
conformance: the evaluator probes create->query->delete before scoring; non-conformant artifacts fail the run with a clear error rather than being scored

file_data.description: raw bytes (base64 when serialized to JSON)

ArtifactAgentQuery.description: Input query field of query_session. Any of text, json, files may be set.

ArtifactAgentOutput.description: Output of query_session. text and json are exposed to the artifact agent user sim; file bytes are NOT (the sim sees only file_type + file_name).

json.description: a JSON-encoded string (must be valid JSON)
